$schema_note: Adding a model: pick a stable slug, fill id + precision (or null) + optional env_override, then wire it up in _models.py if the suite needs a new constant.
invariant: Per modality, the llama_cpp and QAIRT cells point at the same family / size / training. AI Hub publishes nothing smaller than Qwen3-4B (LLM) and Qwen2.5-VL-7B (VLM) in the Qwen family, so the GGUF side is lifted to match rather than QAIRT being scaled down. The LLM is Qwen3-4B base — the Instruct-2507 variant emits a long <think>...</think> preamble that pushes the answer off a 256-token budget and turns test_quality_keywords into a thinking-budget test.

llama_cpp_mtp_target.note: gemma-4 is the only publicly published family shipping MTP heads in a llama.cpp-compatible GGUF today. A4B is the smallest for which a matching assistant draft repo exists (RachidAR/*assistant is trained against A4B; pairing with the smaller E2B target fails graph shape check).
